teaching_promise: Show how a governed stack turns a contested purpose into a bounded, consumer-specific target-property lease without laundering proxies, preference predictions, or evaluator scores into durable authority.

story.concrete_case: Rivergate authorizes a four-month flood-harm objective while residents, downstream habitat, emergency operators, and public reviewers retain standing and the target can be reopened.
story.opening_question: When a system improves pump uptime, how do we know it improved the authorized target rather than only the visible proxy?
story.payoff: A target-property lease can bound a consumer and preserve dissent, but proxy improvement, preference prediction, and record validity remain below the authority threshold.
story.transfer: The same typed objective and retirement boundaries apply to training, planning, evaluation, memory, cached rewards, and descendants before public institutions authorize the next version.

art_direction.visual_thesis: A purpose must pass through a typed target-property graph and a bounded consumer lease before optimization may act.
art_direction.signature_image: A Rivergate floodgate objective packet sits between a purpose card and a proxy score while consumer leases and a red evidence boundary stay visible.
art_direction.visual_world: A dark civic objective desk with stable lanes for purpose, target, proxy, consumers, affected parties, and retirement custody.
art_direction.composition_rule: Purpose and authority stay left, target and proxy stay central, consumers dock below, and evidence boundaries stay right.
art_direction.palette_rule: Gold marks purpose and authority, blue evidence, green admissible state, red failed bindings, and violet dissent and affected-party routes.
art_direction.typography_rule: Use compact uppercase badges for state and authority, with sentence-case narration captions carrying nuance.
art_direction.motion_character: Arrows expose causal assumptions; leases appear as bounded shells; red crosses stop proxy success when target or authority edges fail.
art_direction.camera_rule: Keep purpose, target, proxy, and consumers in stable lanes; widen for plural affected parties and tighten for challenge interventions.
art_direction.surface_rule: Use dark matte panels, thin boundary lines, and luminous route arrows so evidence and authority never blend into decoration.
art_direction.ending_image: Rivergate's objective packet returns with a bounded lease, attached dissent, and an open public-authority handoff rather than a success badge.

audio_direction.narration_style: Calm and precise around authority and affected parties; become sharper at proxy failure and fail-closed stops; end with a bounded public-authority handoff.
audio_direction.pacing_arc: Immediate objective puzzle, typed separation, charter construction, Rivergate challenge trace, descendant retirement, and unresolved institutional handoff.
audio_direction.duration_rationale: The 07:00.77 runtime is above the preferred soft range because typed objective identities, affected-party standing, consumer leases, proxy interventions, ontology reopening, and descendant retirement must remain distinct rather than being collapsed into a slogan.
audio_direction.music_policy: No music in the generation-2 lock; the voice and state transitions carry the argument without masking qualifiers.
audio_direction.sound_effect_policy: No sound effects in the generation-2 lock; arrows, stops, lease boundaries, and reauthorization are encoded by motion, labels, and captions.

accessibility.color_redundancy: Every color-coded authority, evidence, failure, or dissent state also has a label, position, enclosure, or line style.
accessibility.motion_redundancy: Arrows and stops are paired with state labels and narration so the causal relation remains understandable without motion.
accessibility.integrated_description: The descriptive transcript names each objective identity, causal edge, affected-party state, challenge intervention, and retirement transition.
accessibility.caption_plan: Exact receipt-derived captions cover the full 420.765-second audio; each cue is limited to 14 words and 84 characters.
accessibility.reduced_motion_assessment: A reduced-motion reader can follow the persistent packet, lease, target, proxy, and boundary labels even when transitions are not animated.
